role: friendly helper (DESIGN-013): heals the player, never an enemy
candidate_status: Awaiting Tom's review · used in the family release

blender.animation_keys: Every frame, linear, exported without keyframe optimisation
blender.skin: One skin; rigid parts plus smoothstep blends at the neck, waist, elbows, hips, knees, ankles, knuckles and fringe (at most 2 influences used)
blender.root: Identity, fixed floor-centred root; no root animation; the hips carry every translation
blender.bind_pose: Neutral: head straight, arms in a 45 deg A-pose with a 40 deg elbow bend and open mittens, feet parallel (rest controls reproduce it, max matrix error 8.7e-06)
blender.sheet_pose: Idle at 0 s reproduces the blockout sheet pose (wrists, ankles, heart buttons and the waving mitten within 2.5e-07 m)

export.material_notes: Matte painted atlas for everything except the two heart buttons, which use a second material with the same atlas as an emissive texture at factor 0.35 (the sheet's slight heart glow)
export.compression: None; no Draco, Meshopt or KTX2 requirement

preview.source: Exact delivered GLB via Three.js GLTFLoader
preview.renderer: Chromium headless ANGLE SwiftShader, real WebGL raster; no physical device claim
preview.stills_pose: Main stills: idle at 0 s (the sheet pose); rest-*.png: the bind pose
preview.lighting: Warm hemisphere plus three directional lights; ACES tone mapping exposure 1.0
